"Mace!" "Right on." Mace makes his first appearance in this game along with his other Jedi pals in this set. Sporting impressive numbers like some of the other strong Jedi Masters, he also has good game text when it comes to Amidala. Like other Episode I Jedi, he's lived the good life in the Council Chamber so he will feel more comfortable there and gain all his useful game text. One great use for Mace is taking on the Agents Of The Black Sun objective. They will not be able to deploy [[Maul]] so they will automatically lose 2 Force when you have Mace at the Chamber and Amidala wandering at a battleground site. Can you dig that? Just watch out for Xizor and the Emperor who happen to live on [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]] too. Combo: Mace stays, others go away. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner]] provides a simple lesson for how the problem can be avoided altogether. The youthful [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] Expansion version of Obi-wan has a higher power than his Classic Trilogy versions. As a result, he cannot be replaced by those versions via persona replacement. Similarly, his ability is lower than those versions, meaning that the older [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Kenobi]] cannot be replaced with the younger one. This is a simple mechanic with no new persona rules to learn, just the use of an already-established rule. As the expansion title suggests, young Obi-wan is strongly linked to [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] in his usefulness. First, he receives a generous deploy bonus to [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] that allows him to deploy for a pittance of 4 Force. Not bad for a character with 6 power and 5 ability, plus a healthy amount of immunity to attrition. But what makes our young Padawan really interesting is his 'teleporting' gametext. When the Dark Side player initiates a battle at a related [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] site, Obi-wan can relocate to the battle for 2 Force, giving the Light Side an added power boost in the battle, not to mention the chance to hit a character if Obi-wan is carrying his lightsaber. The Dark Side will have to carefully consider when and where to battle on [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] in order to effectively deal with the teleporting Jedi hit-man. And getting young Obi-wan into play is helped by the gametext of [[Padmé Naberrie]], who lets [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Kenobi]] deploy from the Reserve Deck. Obi-wan [[Obi-Wan Kenobi{{!}}Kenobi]], Padawan Learner continues the tradition of great personae of [[Ben Kenobi]]. The only trick is deciding which one to use. |combos=* [[Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner]] + [[Krayt Dragon Howl]][https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Obi-Wan%20Kenobi%2C%20Padawan%20Learner Scomp: Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec). C-3P0 was not to be sold when Anakin left with [[Qui-Gon Jinn]] for [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]]. POWER 1 Protocol Droid If in a battle with Shmi at a site, once per battle may place top card of your Used Pile on top of your Reserve Deck. Once per turn may place a card from hand into your Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck. DEPLOY 2 FORFEIT 3 The Episode I version of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] is a great card for anyone who likes to have full control over their deck. [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] shares [[Mirax Terrik]]'s ability to circulate high destiny cards back into your deck and replace them with new cards from the Reserve Deck. What's even nicer about [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]]'s ability is that, unlike Mirax, his ability can be used for free, and instead of placing the card on the bottom of the Used Pile, he places it on the top of the Used Pile for easier tracking when your Reserve Deck is larger. The other nice thing about [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]]'s ability to place a high destiny card on top of your Used Pile is that if he's in a battle with Shmi, he can then take that high destiny card and place it on top of your Reserve Deck, ensuring a nice pull for weapon or battle destiny. And since Shmi can download [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] right out of the Reserve Deck, the odds of you having them in a battle together are pretty good. The fact that this is a persona of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}C-3PO]] also has enormous benefits. Because most versions of [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}C-3PO]] have only been strong in specialized decks, many of his support cards are quite powerful. For example, [[Were You Looking For Me?]] is a handy 5 Destiny Used Interrupt that allows you to pull [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] and/or another protocol droid (like [[R-3PO (Ar-Threepio){{!}}R-3PO]]) from your Reserve Deck. You can also use the same Interrupt as a Lost Interrupt to either retrieve [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] from the Lost Pile or to add a battle destiny when [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] is helping his friends out in battle (two battle destiny if he happens to have a few furry friends with him). Unlike most "back" cards, this card is very appealing because it's recyclable, free, high destiny, and has the battle destiny bonus. There are tons of other [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}C-3PO]] suppport cards, including the ever-popular [[How Did We Get Into This Mess?]], but one of my favorites is [[Artoo, I Have A Bad Feeling About This]], which has three different uses, the best of which allows you to squash your opponent's battle destiny completely if both [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Artoo]] and [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}C-3PO]] are together in battle. Put Shmi, [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace){{!}}Artoo]] and [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}Threepio]] together in a battle, and with the right support cards you can really put the hurt on the Dark Side.https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/threepiowithhispartsshow.html |combos=* [[Threepio With His Parts Showing]] + [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle]] [[Chewie With Blaster Rifle]] adds one battle destiny if with [[C-3PO (See-Threepio){{!}}C-3PO]].[https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Threepio%20With%20His%20Parts%20Showing Scomp: Threepio With His Parts Showing]; card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/blob/d4e661ec/Light.json swccg-card-json Light.json] (commit d4e661ec).
